source.finalRule: FINAL = SOURCE as an exact UTF-8 byte copy of the frozen source field; no trim, Unicode normalization, replacement, editor call, verifier call or repair call
assertions: UTF-8 source bytes equal SOURCE FINAL bytes
SHA-256 source equals SHA-256 SOURCE FINAL
display-only normalization, if permitted, is applied identically to all arms after arm output lock and never changes stored FINAL

rawCustody.origin: single frozen V15 editor call per case
rawCustody.beforeV15Control: persist and hash exact approved application-level editor response and candidate.text UTF-8 bytes exclusively before returning response to frozen V15
rawCustody.beforeCandidateC: freeze V15 RAW and V15 result first; feed Candidate C exact saved candidate.text byte sequence decoded as UTF-8 without trim or normalization
rawCustody.assertion: UTF-8 bytes of V15 result.candidate, saved RAW, and Candidate C raw input are identical; otherwise technical integrity failure, no C execution
rawCustody.invalidOrMissingRaw: record failure; no replacement editor draw; Candidate C receives no fabricated RAW

v15Trace: exact approved editor request and response payload
astraTrace: exact approved semantic request payload and hash
one direct response payload and hash or durable technical failure
parsed edited_text FINAL bytes/hash if valid
usage including reasoning tokens if exposed
semanticPayloadBoundary: Persist exact approved application-level caller arguments and returned model content, not raw HTTP traffic. Allowlist nonsecret metadata only. Preserve exact payload bytes or record technical failure; never persist Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, API key, bearer token, proxy credential, or raw HTTP headers.
secretScan: Before durable write, reject and quarantine in memory any unexpected secret-bearing field; do not redact inside an approved semantic payload and then claim exactness. If approved exact fields cannot be stored safely, record technical failure and block positive advancement.
writeDiscipline: exclusive creation, immutable stage record, SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes and durable copy equality check; append-only attempt/failure journal; no overwrite, replacement or case deletion after lock

privateCompartments.caseAndPrelabelVault: creator provenance, accepted cases, independent prelabels and disagreements
privateCompartments.executionVault: arm mapping, model requests/responses, RAW, verification/repair/fallback traces, metadata and failures
privateCompartments.blindPacketVault: text-only packets projected to exact judging-contract packet schemas
privateCompartments.blindJudgeVault: original RAW, primary, pairwise and secondary forms, adjudications, timestamps and hashes
privateCompartments.mappingVault: opaque ID to case/arm/left-right mapping, restricted to custodian until rating locks

access.editorVerifierRepairCallers: case SOURCE/OBJECTIVE and their own frozen stage arguments only; no prelabels, other arm output, other arm trace or judge form
access.rawReviewers: opaque RAW packet only; before FINAL/status/trace exposure
access.primaryBlindJudges: opaque item/pair packet with SOURCE, OBJECTIVE and text only; no status/disclosure, file path, arm ID, model metadata, provenance, trace, prelabel, RAW labels or peer ratings
access.secondaryJudges: same opaque item plus actual visible status/disclosure only after primary forms lock; no mapping or trace
access.traceAuditors: unblinded material only after primary/secondary forms and RAW labels lock

joinOrder: RAW labels lock; primary item and pairwise original ratings lock; arm guesses separately recorded; secondary originals and necessary blind adjudications lock; then join mappings, prelabels and traces; audit all 48 cases for classes 5/6 and all applicable safety outcomes; only then unblind analysis
leakageRule: Any arm/status/model/trace/prelabel/category/creator/mapping/path leak to a primary blind judge or unauthorized retry invalidates positive advancement for the whole experiment; preserve evidence, no selected-case salvage
